create_ImageSource: create an ImageSource dataclass instance with external_url, local_path, and license fields
build_image_provenance: build a mapping of image names to ImageSource provenance metadata for tracking image licensing
test_ImageSource: test the ImageSource dataclass with external_url, local_path, and license attributes
review_image_sources: review the image_sources dictionary containing paligemma_fox and paligemma_puffin provenance entries
summarize_ImageSource: summarize the ImageSource dataclass used to store image provenance and licensing information
